_guide: // experience.json - one timeline entry per role in the Experience section.
// schemaVersion: always 1. It tells the loader which shape to expect; do not change it.
// section: heading text plus on/off switches for search, filters, sorting and detail views.
// REQUIRED per role: id, role. Everything else is optional and hidden when empty.
// id: unique and stable, prefix exp- (exp-001). Career Timeline references it.
// role: job title, e.g. 'Freelance web developer'.
// company.name: employer name. Empty hides the company badge.
// company.website / company.logo: optional; website must be a full https URL.
// employmentType: 'Full-time', 'Part-time', 'Freelance', 'Internship'.
// workArrangement: 'Remote', 'Hybrid' or 'On-site'.
// location: where the role was based.
// dates: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. current true with no endDate renders 'Present'.
// shortDescription: one line on the timeline card.
// description: longer text behind 'Show details'.
// responsibilities: bullet list of what you did.
// achievements: bullet list of results, e.g. 'Cut report time from 10 to 2 minutes'.
// skills: technology names shown as badges.
// relatedSkillIds / relatedProjectIds: ids from the other datasets, used by search and the timeline.
// featured: true emphasises the marker.
// order: manual position. enabled: false hides the record.
// isSample: true marks example content; the section then shows a notice.
